notes: «أَبِی ره» is the compiler's father, a bare relation; he is not named here.
The Imam after «عن» is a narrator (owner ruling 2).
«قُلْتُ مَا مَعْنَى تَنْقُلُ الرَّحِمَ» is a question inside the saying by an unnamed first-person speaker; whether that speaker is a link in the chain is for ruling.
«وَ أَمَّا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ یَحْیی فَإِنَّهُ رَوَی یُنْقَلُ» is a wording variant from a name already in the chain, so it is left out.
